instructions.title: Dough
items: Beat together the butter and shortening until smooth and creamy and chill until firm.
Sift together the flour, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl.
Using a fork, cut the butter and shortening into the dry ingredients, until the mixture has a consistent texture.
Mix egg yolk, ice water, and vinegar into the dough, then form it into a ball and refrigerate it for 1 hour so that it will be easier to work with.

instructions.title: Bake
items: When dough has chilled, roll it out and press into pie plate.
Press parchment or aluminum foil into crust and weight crust down with ceramic pie plate filled with dried beans.
Bake 15 minutes, then remove weight and prick crust with fork to allow steam to escape.
Bake another 5-10 minutes or until crust is golden brown.
